title: Kraken Robotics technology record refresh

selectedGap.reason: The published profile lists only KATFISH even though current official product evidence supports distinct SeaPower and Kraken SAS capabilities.

guardrailNotes: This batch stages an additive refresh only; the existing organization, KATFISH capability, stable identifiers and prior evidence remain unchanged until a human reviewer explicitly publishes the candidate.
Gmail and LinkedIn were used as discovery inputs only. Every proposed field is supported by a durable Kraken Robotics product or newsroom page.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Kraken Robotics is already published, but its public profile materially understates the official portfolio by representing only KATFISH. Kraken's own product pages establish SeaPower and Kraken SAS as concrete, differentiated technologies, while official order activity corroborates current commercial use. The refresh is additive, preserves the existing record, and gives reviewers a precise two-capability diff backed by durable first-party evidence.
reviewWarnings: LinkedIn supplied discovery provenance only and is not used as field-level evidence.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: Kraken describes SeaPower as a subsea lithium-ion battery with pressure-tolerant encapsulation, integrated battery management and modular systems scalable from compact vehicles to XL platforms.
Kraken announced $35 million in SeaPower battery sales and stated that the batteries support long-endurance uncrewed underwater vehicle operations.
Kraken states that Kraken SAS performs imaging and bathymetric mapping simultaneously with modular arrays, constant swath resolution and real-time full-swath processing.
The official product page identifies mine countermeasures, port and harbour security, critical underwater infrastructure inspection and route survey among Kraken SAS applications.
Kraken's official newsroom lists continuing 2026 business updates and orders involving its subsea battery and synthetic aperture sonar portfolio.
